TSMC announces 1.4nm process roadmap

TSMC laid out its A14 process roadmap at its annual technology symposium on Wednesday, saying the node will enter production in 2028 with a claimed 15 percent speed improvement over N2 at the same power.

The company said A14 will use its second-generation nanosheet transistors and introduce a new standard cell architecture aimed at AI accelerator designs. Analysts noted the roadmap keeps TSMC roughly a node ahead of rivals Samsung and Intel Foundry on announced schedules.

TSMC also detailed advanced packaging capacity expansion, with CoWoS output expected to double again next year to serve datacenter GPU demand.
